India's FTA Exports Surge, Especially to Singapore and Sri Lanka

India's exports to countries with Free Trade Agreements (FTAs) saw a significant increase in the first quarter of fiscal year 2027. Shipments to Singapore and Sri Lanka more than doubled during this period. This surge indicates a growing momentum in trade with FTA partners.
